rationale: No supported optimization is safely applicable without weakening coverage or adding unvalidated limits. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency caching) is already present: every job restores/saves node_modules via OffchainLabs/actions/node-modules/install@main with a lockfile-hashed cache key, so the contraindication "an equivalent cache already exists" applies and adding another cache would be an unrelated no-op. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (job timeout) is not safely derivable: the measured example bounds a fast lint job at 5 minutes, but this workflow's integration jobs build and run a local Arbitrum node with long mocha timeouts, and the repository reports no completed-run duration history (CI history: no_completed_runs), so the precondition "representative successful-duration history exists" is unmet and valid slow runs could exceed any guessed limit. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is explicitly rejected by the workflow: test-integration sets fail-fast: false to run all matrix cells to completion, matching the contraindications "every matrix outcome is required" and "full failure diagnostics are required"; enabling cancellation would reduce coverage. Build and test coverage is preserved unchanged.
